name: labellar_sugar_100hz
what: labellar sweet gustatory receptor neurons driven at 100 Hz: each LB3b and LB3c cell gets an independent Poisson train of membrane kicks for the whole trial (the Shiu et al. 2024 drive, as scripts/assay_pathways.py --assay sugar_mn9 gives it)
evidence: LB3b/LB3c match Gr64f-GAL4 sweet labellar GRN projections (male-CNS taste connectome, bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.08.25.671814; measured identity). 100 Hz is the drive of the existing sugar gate (DECISIONS s8, profiles.py M3), a protocol choice, not a fly quantity
notes: t_off_ms null = to the end of the trial. kick_mv 'profile' = the profile's kick_mv. The Poisson draws come from numpy default_rng(seed + the protocol's stimulus_rng_offset), one uniform per stimulated cell per step while the event is on
